user.title: Connect your Xtatech watchdog
user.description: Install the HA firmware variant, then open its Home Assistant web page to find the API key. Enter the local host without http://.

reconfigure.title: Update device connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the current address and API key for the same watchdog.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your watchdog
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current API key from the device's Home Assistant web page.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the watchdog. Check its address, power and network.
error.unsupported_firmware: The device did not return a supported API. Install the HA firmware variant.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid host, port and 32-character hexadecimal API key.
error.wrong_device: This is a different watchdog. Add it as a separate integration instead.
